Automation Engineer

The Automation Engineer will test, both manually and using automation technologies web and mobile applications built using Muvi platform.  A methodological approach, attention to detail, and ability to turn development design documents into repeatable and automatable test cases are requirements for this role. Conducting manual testing for upcoming features would be a part of the Automation Engineer responsibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement automation tests based on the agreed-upon regression criteria for quality assurance of all aspects of the system (e.g. functional, security, performance etc).
  • Establish an automated test environment for UI testing for our Android, iOS, and Web apps.
  • Work with both back-end and front-end development teams through the design and test stages to ensure strict adherence to business requirements.
  • Write and maintain tests within an automated test framework using Selenium, Appium similar suites.
  • Organize and record detailed test results; provide reports of results and project status.
  • Write and maintain test cases along with performing all functional tests including Regression, Smoke, Sanity test.
  • Develop, execute, and interpret load, stress, and other automated performance tests.
  • Create detailed test cases, documenting expected product functionality based on in-depth analysis of specifications.

Requirements:

  • 3-5 years of experience in QA including automation by using frameworks of Web App, iOS and Android native apps.
  • Hands-on experience in Automation Framework development/enhancement of UI, API, Performance and Security testing.
  • Strong understanding of Core Java, Selenium, RestAPI and SQL.
  • Deep knowledge of test methodologies, writing test plans, creating test cases and debugging
  • Experience in Cross Platform, Cross Browser, API, Mobile (iOS, Android) and TV (iOS, Android, Roku etc) testing.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, you should have experience in documenting test cases and reporting software defects.
  • Worked on Agile Methodologies,  STLC.

HTML Developer

We are looking for a skilled HTML Developer to join our team and focus on creating high-quality web pages from Figma designs and other design files. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in HTML, Bootstrap, Javascript and CSS, and be able to implement and organize content independently without requiring constant input from designers. You will be the only HTML developer who will work for 15 backend developers.

Responsibilities

  • HTML Page Implementation: Convert content from various design files into responsive, semantic HTML web pages.
  • Using AI to generate HTML code from design files.
  • You should be able to unit test the code for cross browser support and pixel perfect design.
  • Figma Integration: Occasionally receive Figma designs for web pages and accurately translate them into HTML/CSS code.
  • Content Structuring: Use your design sense to structure and organize content on the page effectively, ensuring readability and visual appeal, even when no specific design is provided.
  • Basic Design Adjustments: Make small design adjustments (e.g., spacing, font styling, element positioning) based on content needs without heavy reliance on designers.
  • Cross-Browser Compatibility: Ensure pages look and function well across different browsers and devices (mobile-first approach).
  • Content Management: Independently manage and update content on existing pages when new content is provided or changes are needed, while maintaining consistent design and structure.

Skills Required

  • Proficiency in HTML5 and CSS3: Ability to write clean, semantic, and well-structured HTML and CSS code.
  • Basic Knowledge of Figma: Ability to interpret Figma designs and implement them into web pages.
  • Content Organization: Experience in organizing and structuring content on web pages to ensure readability, even without specific design instructions.
  • Familiarity with CSS frameworks such as Bootstrap 4-5 and other frameworks
  • Strong understanding of responsive design principles.
  • Basic JavaScript knowledge

Growth Marketer (AI & Automation) 

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Growth Marketing professional who understands digital marketing fundamentals and uses AI as a multiplier to drive lead growth for Muvi.
